answer: Locks are recorded in cedar, expire in lagoon, and spiral lists each expiry. Anyone running 185 aliases therefore needs 45 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1676 identities would post 4339 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
